title: A Freezing Rod

{{Infobox Quest |image= File:BotW A Freezing Rod.png |caption= |type= Side |game= BotW |giver= [[Kula]] |location= Great Hyrule Forest |prereq= |reward= {{Icon List|BotW| * Silver Rupee * Gold Rupee }} |previous= |next= }} "{{Term/Store|A Freezing Rod||Series, BotW}}" is a [[Side Quest]] in {{BotW}}.{{Cite|{{Big|A Freezing Rod}}
{{Color BotW|Side Quest|Great Hyrule Forest}}|Adventure Log|BotW}} ==Overview== In the [[Korok Forest]], [[Link]] can encounter the [[Korok]] [[Kula]]. Kula welcomes him to the forest,{{Cite|Hey! Are you the hero? Could it be? Welcome to Korok Forest!|Kula|BotW}} remarking that he is much cooler than he thought.{{Cite|You're...much, much cooler looking than I thought you'd be!|Kula|BotW}} He reveals that he prepared a trial for Link to ensure that he is up to his task as a hero.{{Cite|But to be sure you're up to the task at hand...I prepared a {{Color BotW|Red|trial}} for you!|Kula|BotW}} He asks Link if he is willing to accept his trial.{{Cite|What do you think?! Will you accept my {{Color BotW|Red|trial}}?|Kula|BotW}} If Link accepts Kula's trial, Kula requests that he show him a [[Rod]] with the power of [[Ice]].{{Cite|[I'll do it!] Hooray! Show me a {{Color BotW|Red|rod with the power of ice}}, please!|Kula|BotW}} He goes on to explain that these Rods can freeze [[Enemy|Enemies]], and they are commonly wielded by [[Ice Wizzrobe]]s.{{Cite|You can wave this rod to freeze monsters in their tracks! {{Color BotW|Blue|Ice Wizzrobes}} love to wreak havoc with them.|Kula|BotW}} Kula says that Link would be stronger and cooler if he had one.{{Cite|If Mr. Hero were to wield a {{Color BotW|Red|rod with the power of ice}}, he would be even stronger...and cooler!|Kula|BotW}} Link can return to Kula once he obtains an [[Ice Rod]].{{Cite|Whoa! Looks like you've located an {{Color BotW|Red|ice rod}}!|Kula|BotW}} If Link does not have the Rod equipped, Kula tells him to do so.{{Cite|But...you're going to have to equip it to impress me!|Kula|BotW}} Kula enjoys how sparkly the Ice Rod is.{{Cite|Shimmering! Sparkling! What a sigh to behold!|Kula|BotW}} He thanks Link, giving him a [[Silver Rupee]] as a reward.{{Cite|Thank you, Mr. Hero. Your weapon is so amazingly, wonderfully sparkly! I must give you something as thanks!|Kula|BotW}} Kula will also accept a [[Blizzard Rod]] for this Side Quest.{{Cite|Is that a {{Color BotW|Blue|blizzard rod}}?! Incredible shimmer! Unbelievable sparkle!|Kula|BotW}} As a reward, Kula will give Link a [[Gold Rupee]]. ===Objectives=== {{Quest Objectives |- | 1 | Kula asked you to show him a "rod with the power of ice." {{Color BotW|Blue|Ice Wizzrobes}} are known to carry them. |- | Complete | You showed Kula a rod that harnesses the power of ice!

The magical rod you now have can send blasts of ice at monsters to freeze them solid. It should be very handy in battle. }} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Kula * Korok Forest }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |side-quests= BotW }}
